column1: # Stage S10 H1a, first of four: the frontend's test support (the repository-root finder, the captured
# API responses behind `golden!`, the API route tables, the source scrubber, the source shards and the
# `view!` attribute guard) becomes the dev-only crates/frontend/foundation/frontend_test_support. The
# folder becomes the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to
# the moved folder and one `frontend_test_support::` row scoped to the app's source.
